Waterfall increasing marker line objects

Source: R/zz-gen-waterfall.R
go_waterfall_increasing_marker_line.Rd

The object for the increasing.marker.line of a waterfall trace (go_waterfall_increasing_marker()). go_waterfall_increasing_marker_line() creates one, with exactly its properties; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_waterfall_increasing_marker_line(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  color = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

arg

Optional named list, or graph object of the same type, to initialise properties from. Named arguments take precedence.

...

Not used: properties must be named in full.

color

Sets the line color of all increasing values. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

width

Sets the line width of all increasing values. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_waterfall_increasing_marker_line object (a named list).

Details

Nested objects are named lists, or objects of the constructors their arguments name. Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when the object is created or modified. A property may be a one-sided formula (color = ~col): it is kept, and evaluated in the data (then checked) when its trace is added to a figure with add_<trace>() or add_trace().

Examples

mtcars |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_waterfall(
    x = ~factor(cyl),
    y = ~mpg,
    increasing = go_waterfall_increasing(
      marker = go_waterfall_increasing_marker(
        line = go_waterfall_increasing_marker_line(color = "red")
      )
    )
  )
